test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:
"A doctor who treats children."
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Pediatrician**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Pediatrician"** refers to a doctor who specializes in the medical care and treatment of children. (बच्चों के डॉक्टर)
 
 
• **Example:** The pediatrician prescribed some medicine for the child's fever.
 
 
• A pediatrician deals with physical, emotional, and social health issues in children from birth to adolescence. (बच्चों के स्वास्थ्य और विकास से संबंधित डॉक्टर)
 
 
• **Example:** Parents often consult pediatricians for vaccinations and routine check-ups for their children.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Pediatrician**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cardiologist** (हृदय रोग विशेषज्ञ): A doctor who specializes in diagnosing and treating heart diseases.
 
 
• **Example:** The cardiologist recommended surgery to address the patient's heart condition.
 
 
 
 
• **Neurologist** (तंत्रिका रोग विशेषज्ञ): A doctor who specializes in the diagnosis and treatment of nervous system disorders, including the brain and spinal cord.
 
 
• **Example:** The neurologist is treating the patient for chronic migraines.
 
 
 
 
• **Gynecologist** (स्त्री रोग विशेषज्ञ): A doctor who specializes in women's reproductive health.
 
 
• **Example:** The gynecologist performed a routine check-up for the expecting mother.
